title: What If the Earth Suddenly Stopped Spinning?

scenes.text: What if Earth stopped spinning? The danger isn't the dark. It's the wind.
At the equator, the ground moves about a thousand miles an hour. The air would not stop with it.
Within minutes, winds near that speed would strip soil, trees and buildings off the surface, flinging everything eastward.
Then a single day would last about half a year. Six months of blazing sun, six months of freezing dark.
Hurricanes would vanish, because they depend on the spin. So might Earth's magnetic field, which the spinning core helps drive.
Over time the oceans would drift toward the poles, exposing land at the equator. A new planet, from one missing motion.

description:
What if the Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
The ground at the equator moves around a thousand miles an hour. The air would keep going, and a single day would last about half a year.
